ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: From the problem statement, it is known that the solution set of the inequality ax^2-x+b\ge 0 is the closed interval [-2,1]. Therefore the two zeros of the quadratic function ax^2-x+b are x=-2 and x=1. Because the solution set of \ge 0 is between the two roots, the parabola opens downward, that is, a<0. Thus we can set ax^2-x+b=a(x+2)(x-1). Expanding gives a(x+2)(x-1)=a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a. Comparing with ax^2-x+b for the coefficient of the linear term, we have a=-1; then comparing the constant term, we have b=-2a=2. Substituting a=-1, b=2 into the inequality to be found bx^2-x+a\le 0 gives 2x^2-x-1\le 0. Factoring gives (2x+1)(x-1)\le 0. Its two zeros are x=-\frac12 and x=1, and the coefficient of the quadratic term is positive, so the solution set of the inequality \le 0 is the closed interval between the two roots, namely [-\frac12,1].

method.method_draft: 从题干读取：不等式 ax^2-x+b≥0 的解集是闭区间 [-2,1]。据此判断二次函数 ax^2-x+b 的两个零点为 -2 和 1，且因为 ≥0 的解集在两根之间，所以开口向下，a<0。将二次式写成 a(x+2)(x-1)=a x^2+a x-2a。与 ax^2-x+b 对比一次项系数，得 a=-1，再由常数项得 b=2。代入待求不等式 bx^2-x+a≤0，得到 2x^2-x-1≤0，因式分解为 (2x+1)(x-1)≤0，所以解集为 [-1/2,1]。
method.CoT_raw: 从题干可知，不等式 ax^2-x+b\ge 0 的解集为闭区间 [-2,1]。因此二次函数 ax^2-x+b 的两个零点是 x=-2 和 x=1。因为 \ge 0 的解集在两根之间，所以抛物线开口向下，即 a<0。于是可设 ax^2-x+b=a(x+2)(x-1)。展开得 a(x+2)(x-1)=a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a。与 ax^2-x+b 对比一次项系数，有 a=-1；再对比常数项，有 b=-2a=2。将 a=-1, b=2 代入待求不等式 bx^2-x+a\le 0，得到 2x^2-x-1\le 0。因式分解为 (2x+1)(x-1)\le 0。其两个零点为 x=-\frac12 和 x=1，且二次项系数为正，所以不等式 \le 0 的解集为两根之间的闭区间，即 [-\frac12,1]。
